items.title: Watch: SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast
items.dek: A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July and crashed into the Indian Ocean hadn't been seen since - but now Christmas Island residents say they have
items.body: A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July and crashed into the Indian Ocean hadn't been seen since - but now Christmas Island residents say they have spotted it being towed just off their coast.
items.author: IriLine Desk

items.title: Retail giant Target receives $1bn boost from tariff refunds
items.dek: The US chain said it received a $994 million pre-tax reimbursement, which resulted in its second quarter operating income rising to $2.6bn.

items.title: Trump administration can target Ethiopians for deportation
items.dek: A judge's ruling on Tuesday removed the last remaining block on Trump officials' efforts to cancel Temporary Protected Status for Ethiopians.
